These are the three places in openmrs-esm-patient-chart that call `defineExtensionConfigSchema`. I found them with one text search of the checkout and did not open the files or check the schemas they pass in. I also did not look at the function's definition in openmrs-esm-core.

1. **`esm-patient-flags-app`**: `src/index.ts` registers schemas for the `patient-flags-risk-count` and `patient-flags-list` extensions (lines 12–13). The import is on line 1.
2. **`esm-generic-patient-widgets-app`**: `src/index.ts` registers schemas for the `obs-by-encounter-widget` and `obs-table-horizontal-widget` extensions (lines 21–22). The import is on line 1.
3. **`esm-patient-banner-app`**: `src/index.ts` registers a schema for the `person-attribute-tag` extension (line 25). The import is in the multi-line import starting on line 3.
